content: Vercel Hobby plan: 100GB bandwidth/mo, function timeout 10s (up to 60s configurable, 300s only on Pro), 4hrs Active CPU/mo, hard cap with no overage (app goes offline until reset), and Hobby is licensed for non-commercial use only — a revenue-generating business site technically requires a Pro plan. Cron jobs on Hobby: max 2 jobs, daily-only frequency, imprecise timing within the scheduled hour.
